### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, touching **9** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via validateSecurityPosture (symbol, a top-level function))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v13.mdx`  _(via validateSecurityPosture (symbol, a top-level function))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fdad1786e892270ac3fcc161b3fd4d57c9c47748` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a33c42c34ae447c2d92c3de199bb10426a9419bc` — the merge of head `8aeb321249e63c295e811b973421491e1871d3c9` into base `fdad1786e892270ac3fcc161b3fd4d57c9c47748`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a33c42c34ae447c2d92c3de199bb10426a9419bc && git checkout a33c42c34ae447c2d92c3de199bb10426a9419bc
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fdad1786e892270ac3fcc161b3fd4d57c9c47748 8aeb321249e63c295e811b973421491e1871d3c9 && git checkout -B drift-repro fdad1786e892270ac3fcc161b3fd4d57c9c47748 && git merge --no-ff 8aeb321249e63c295e811b973421491e1871d3c9

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fdad1786e892270ac3fcc161b3fd4d57c9c47748
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs fdad1786e892270ac3fcc161b3fd4d57c9c47748` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f85110db2abcffbc7ebc93977fb58358413e34b1`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the PR diff against merge-base `cfb602c459` (all 7 files); `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts` (head and main; `recordsOf` :215, `packagesOf` :264, `strName` :285, the new fold :368-495); `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` (main :669-800 and head :746-770, :1006-1019); `packages/lint/src/validate-membership-key-declarations.ts` (main :208-275, head :264-268); `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture-fls-extension.test.ts`; `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture-extension-merge.test.ts`; `packages/lint/src/validate-membership-key-declarations.test.ts` (cases :82-254); `packages/lint/src/object-graph.test.ts` (junk cases :264-344); `packages/lint/src/validate-related-list-refs.ts` :125-135; `packages/lint/src/validate-mapping-target-fields.ts` :96-118; `packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts` :116-139; `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` at main (`registerObject` :4401-4698, `extensionTargetKey` :6530-6560, `resolveObjectKey` :6302-6318, `foldExtendersOntoDefinition` :4792-4880, `mergeObjectDefinitions` :814-866, `withoutExtensionQueueField` :5008-5025, `extendContributionRefusal` :2122-2130); `packages/objectql/src/registry-extension-legacy-key-fold.test.ts`; `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (`ObjectExtensionSchema` :4965-5125); `packages/cli/src/utils/stack-collections.ts` :356-392; `packages/cli/src/utils/artifact-packages.ts` :114-186; `packages/cli/src/utils/extension-field-suffix.ts`; `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` (:144, :316, :493-560); `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (:9-15, :1807-1842); card #30303 body and 4 comments (os-dev-report 6652637028 included); PR #30359 body, 2 comments, 0 reviews; check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Fidelity of the fold (judged, no must-fix). `objectExtensionsByTarget` mirrors `registerApp` step 2b plus the `extend` arm exactly where it matters for the served NAME set: (a) one entry per package per target, the later replacing the earlier whole (`registry.ts` :4666-4669 `findIndex(c => c.packageId === packageId && c.ownership === 'extend')` then splice; fold `object-graph.ts` :418 `filter(other => other.carrier !== carrier)`); (b) ascending `priority`, default 200 (`engine-registration.ts` :120 `ext.priority ?? 200`; `registry.ts` :4690; fold :435-437), equal priorities in registration order; (c) `fields` merged by name additively, later writer replacing the whole field (`mergeObjectDefinitions` :825-827 `{ ...base.fields, ...extension.fields }`; fold :467-476); (d) `fieldPatches` add no field (`applyFieldPatches` reaches `ownFields` only, :856-864) and the fold does not read them; (e) audit (`applyAuditFieldGovernance`) and `queue` (`withoutExtensionQueueField` :5008-5025) governance replace or drop the extender's DEFINITION but the platform column of that name stands, so the served name set is unchanged; (f) `extendContributionRefusal` (:2122-2130) refuses `defaultRowScope` / `membershipKeys`, keys `registerApp` never copies onto `extDef` (:122-135) and `ObjectExtensionSchema` (a `strictObject`) refuses, so unreachable from a manifest entry; (g) array shape only on both sides (`engine-registration.ts` :116 `Array.isArray(manifest.objectExtensions)`; fold :416 and :447), map-shaped `objects` and `fields` read through `recordsOf` as the runtime's map branch reads them (:103-110); (h) an extension of an object no body declares is listed by the fold but folded onto nothing, and the FLS check's skip 1 leaves the object unjudged, as before; (i) `extend: 'crm__crm_contract'` against an object named `crm_contract`: `resolveObjectKey` (:6302-6318) finds no short-name match and no FQN, so the registry files it under its own spelling, owner-less and unserved; the lint refusal pin matches. ADR-0146 D10's `__c` door (`extension-field-suffix.ts` :8-10) refuses only `__c` outside a `.custom` pair and non-`__c` inside one, so a module package's `o2c_probe_note` is admitted there, as the card measured. No field the lint now accepts is one the runtime would not serve.
2. The refactor is behaviour-preserving for #23210 and the membership-key check by reading: the CBP target set and blame loop are untouched (head :727-745, :750-770); the old `Map<number, VisibleExtension>` set-replace and the new filter-push give the same list once sorted by (priority, carrier), carriers being unique per target; the membership check's `names.has(entry.extend)` pre-filter becomes a no-op because `objectsAsServed` folds only onto declared `objects` (:452-456); the tie tracking is the same expression. One acknowledged change: the extension `path` carrier index is the raw `packages[]` index, not the `packagesOf`-filtered one (PR acceptance note), differing only on an artifact the schema refuses; unpinned, acceptable. Existing pins that cover the two folds: `validate-security-posture-extension-merge.test.ts` :48-122 (array field form, cross-package path `packages[0].manifest.objectExtensions[0].fields`, undeclared target unjudged) and `validate-membership-key-declarations.test.ts` :110-136 (merged U, tied priority unjudged). No finding moved on them by reading; the dev reports both files green, CI `Test Core` shards were `in_progress` at review time.
3. Pins: the four the card needs are all present and double-shaped (per-package body with `packages[]` context and the union, matching `packageBodyAsStack` :182-186 and `authoringRuleUnionStack` :356-392): sibling extension accepted (test 1), unknown field still refused with `where` and `message` byte-equal to a single-object control (test 3), in-body single-package extension accepted (test 4), and three registry-unmerged shapes refused (same-package replaced entry with its reversed twin, `fieldPatches`-only, other spelling). Each stack is parsed by `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` first. Ablation 1 (`indexObjectGraph(stack)` back) reddens tests 1, 3, 4, 5 and the reversed twin = 5 of 8, as reported; ablation 2 (drop the per-package filter) reddens only the replaced-entry pin = 1 of 8, as reported. Both are real reds. Gap: no junk-input pin on the two new exports (`null` stack, `packages: [null]`, non-array `objectExtensions`, non-record entry, junk `fields`, string `priority`); by reading each is tolerated (:412-418, :446-449, `recordsOf`), but `object-graph.test.ts` :264-344 is the file that pins this seam's junk tolerance and the new exports are not in it.
4. Census: `git grep indexObjectGraph(` at head gives exactly the fourteen non-test call sites in the table; twelve index declared objects only (`validate-sharing-rule-enforceability.ts` :589 indexes the declared anchor), so they share the blind spot by reading. None is fixed for free: no input moved. Carrying is right; the fix per rule is a switch to `objectsAsServed` with its own acceptance and refusal pins, each a Clause-② widening of its own. The "no third copy" claim holds for the merged-field-set folds, but two private extension readers remain outside it: `validate-related-list-refs.ts` :132 (top-level `objectExtensions` only, no `packages[]`, no per-package rule) and `validate-mapping-target-fields.ts` :103-118 (top level AND every body, additive, no per-package rule).
5. Declarations: PR body and changeset both carry `Clause-②: yes (widening: …)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`; `readClause2Line` reads `yes` with arm `widening` (`clause2-line.mjs` :316, first token inside the parenthesis), `readMetadataProtocolLine` reads `none`, and the changeset grades `@objectstack/lint` `patch`, the level `none` owes. `Check Changeset` is green on the head. Body matches code except the known eleven-versus-twelve count (twelve "no" rows, prose says "eleven"). No governed surface in the file list; 485 changed lines.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/lint` patch. A lint refusal narrows (fewer false `security-fls-unknown-field` findings); no authorable key, value or default changes; rule id, severity, `where`, path and message of a true unknown are unchanged (test 3 pins byte-equality). `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are the right pair.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Lint imports no runtime; the fold restates the registry by reading, with the registry's own lines cited in its docblock (:385-388). The one divergence is in the safe direction: an `extend` spelled as a short name that `extensionTargetKey` folds onto a legacy `<ns>__<name>` owner (#28858, `registry.ts` :6530-6560) is served by the runtime and still refused by lint, a false positive on a deprecated spelling, not a false negative.
- `validate-security-posture.test.ts` :1651-1665 now reads `object-graph.ts` by two string anchors and throws when either is missing, so a later edit of the fold's position reddens the meta-test loudly rather than silently narrowing the scan.
- Carried tier: the twelve rules and the two private readers above are the seat's follow-up cards, none security-rated in the accepting direction.

### ④ Design judgment

The fix is at the right layer (lint's object index, not a consumer fallback) and in the right shape: one exported fold next to `indexObjectGraph`, consumed by the three rules that judge merged field sets, with the registry's semantics named line by line. Should-fix, in order: (1) add the junk-input pins for `objectExtensionsByTarget` and `objectsAsServed` to `object-graph.test.ts` alongside the existing `indexObjectGraph` / `packagesOf` cases; (2) correct the body's "eleven" to twelve; (3) soften "`extend` names its target verbatim" in the fold docblock and body to "as spelled; the #28858 short-name fold onto a legacy key is not mirrored (refused here, served there)"; (4) name `validate-related-list-refs.ts` and `validate-mapping-target-fields.ts` in the carried census as extension readers the shared fold could absorb. None blocks landing; landing waits on the still-running required contexts (`Build Core`, `Test Core`, `Type Check`, `Lint`) going green.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 权限集 `fields` 里的「对象.字段」键，现在按注册表实际提供的对象来判断字段是否存在：对象自己声明的字段，加上同一制品里任何包通过 `objectExtensions` 加的字段。真不存在的字段照旧报 `security-fls-unknown-field`。
- **为什么改：** HotCRM 的应用包给模块包扩展出来的字段配权限，构建和 `objectstack dev` 都被这条规则拒绝，而运行时明明提供这个字段。hotcrm#2315 第 1 阶段因此卡住。
- **风险与回滚：** 只放宽拒绝，不新增拒绝。合并规则照抄注册表。原有的两份扩展合并逻辑（#23210 的 controlled-by-parent 和 membership-key）收成一份共享实现，原测试全绿。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts` 的 `objectExtensionsByTarget` / `objectsAsServed`；`validate-security-posture-fls-extension.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-security-posture-fls-extension.test.ts`，8 例全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：fable 契约复审 PASS，没有必须修的。四条建议都已采纳：补了 6 个异常输入的钉，注释写明不跟注册表做短名折叠（这样偏向拒绝，是安全方向），正文的普查也改正了。另有 12 条规则有同样的盲点，已另开卡 #30383。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:spec#3 · head `8aeb321249e63c295e811b973421491e1871d3c9`

- **Shape:** 9 files on `origin/main` `bfca0efb`, in two commits, all under `packages/lint`:
  - one shared fold in `object-graph.ts` (`objectExtensionsByTarget`, `objectsAsServed`) mirroring the registry's `objectExtensions` merge;
  - the FLS-key check in `validate-security-posture.ts` indexes `objectsAsServed(stack)`;
  - the #23210 controlled-by-parent merge and the membership-key check read the same fold;
  - new pins for the FLS case, plus 6 junk-input pins for the two exports;
  - a patch changeset.
- **Premise measured:** at `bfca0efb`, the FLS-key index was built from declared objects only, while the controlled-by-parent checks already folded extensions (the card's measurement on HotCRM 18.3.0).
- **Gates:** at `8aeb3212`, lint suite 194/194 files (8015 passed, 5 skipped); type check and the full turbo build exit 0; all 59 derived gates exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 59/59 with 0 NOT-MEASURED. Check-runs on this head: 54 success, 9 skipped, 0 red.
- **Contract review:**
  - Full review, 6652808053 on `f85110db`: PASS, no must-fix. It checked the fold against the registry on every served-name-set axis (one entry per package per target, ascending priority with default 200, fields merged by name, `fieldPatches` add no field, an owner-less `extend` filed nowhere). It found the #23210 and membership-key refactor behaviour-preserving by reading, and confirmed both ablations go red.
  - The seat read the round-1 delta (2 files, +97 −1; no code path changed): the six junk-input pins, and a docblock saying the fold does not mirror #28858's short-name filing onto a legacy `ns__name` owner, so such a key stays refused (the safe direction). Body r1 corrects the census count to twelve and names the two private readers.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: yes (widening: the FLS-key check accepts extension-added fields)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `@objectstack/lint` patch. ADR-0087 not needed.
- **Accepted deviations:** the #28858 short-name fold is not mirrored; it is stated in the docblock and refuses rather than admits.
- **Carried:** the twelve field-path rules and the two private extension readers with the same blind spot are filed as #30383 (p2, Blocked-by #30303).
- **Landing:** not governed (485 lines). The hand-off is `pr_ready` now. Auto-merge waits for PR #30368: `main` currently fails `check-liveness` on a row moved by #30341, which bounces every queue build (PR #30321 was bounced twice). The seat arms auto-merge once #30368 lands.
